description:
e-School ERP is all-in-one school management software that makes running a school easier every day. We offer advanced ERP solutions that include a biometric and QR code attendance system, a digital diary, an automated timetable, the ability to assign a Proxy teacher, an ID card, a report card, class activities, and a way for parents to communicate with their children through a mobile app. We work with schools in Mumbai and all over India.

Our Student and Parent Mobile App is made so that parents and kids can stay in touch with school at all times and from anywhere. The app lets you see important details like attendance, homework, test scores, notices, and school news in real time. Parents can easily see how their child is doing in school.
